bibleget-tracking-category: Name of the tracking category for pages with failed Bible quotes.
bibleget-tracking-category-desc: Description of the tracking category [[Special:TrackingCategories]] for pages with failed Bible quotes.
bibleget-toolong-category: Name of the tracking category for pages with Bible quotes cut to the verse limit.
bibleget-toolong-category-desc: Description of the tracking category [[Special:TrackingCategories]] for pages with Bible quotes cut to the verse limit.
bibleget-error-network: Reason shown in the tooltip of a failed Bible quote: no answer from the BibleGet API (network error or timeout).
bibleget-error-status: Reason shown in the tooltip of a failed Bible quote: the BibleGet API answered with an unexpected HTTP status.
bibleget-error-reference: Reason shown in the tooltip of a failed Bible quote: the BibleGet API reported an error for the reference.
bibleget-error-version: Reason shown in the tooltip of a failed Bible quote: the BibleGet API does not know the requested Bible version.
bibleget-error-ratelimit: Reason shown in the tooltip of a failed Bible quote: the user's rate limit or the BibleGet API's rate limit was reached.
bibleget-error-registration: Reason shown in the tooltip of a failed Bible quote: the wiki could not register with, or obtain a working credential from, the BibleGet API.
bibleget-error-clientkey-revoked: Reason shown in the tooltip of a failed Bible quote: the BibleGet API revoked the client key bundled with this release of the extension. A "project key" is an API key obtained from the BibleGet developer pages.
bibleget-error-noref: Error shown in place of a Bible quote when or {{#biblequote:}} is used without a reference.
bibleget-error-toomany: Reason shown in the tooltip of a failed Bible quote: the page already has the maximum number of distinct Bible quotes ($wgBibleGetMaxQuotesPerPage).
bibleget-error-setup:
Reason shown in the tooltip of a failed Bible quote when the extension's database tables are missing or cannot be used, usually because the wiki administrator has not run update.php after installing or upgrading the extension.

"update.php" is the name of a MediaWiki maintenance script and should not be translated.
bibleget-error-site-address: Reason shown in the tooltip of a failed Bible quote when the wiki's address ($wgCanonicalServer) is not a public https address, so the wiki does not register with the BibleGet service, and it has no project key.
bibleget-note-cut:
Note shown at the end of a Bible quote that was cut to the verse limit.

Parameters:
* $1 - the maximum number of verses shown for one quote
bibleget-popup-close: Tooltip and accessible name of the button that closes a Bible quote popup.
bibleget-source:
Source line under each Bible quote, after an em dash as in a citation.

Parameters:
* $1 - the edition: its full name and year ({{msg-mw|bibleget-source-edition}}), or its abbreviation when BibleGet has not given the full name
* $2 - link to the wiki's page on where its Bible quotes come from ({{msg-mw|bibleget-source-page}}), with the text {{msg-mw|bibleget-source-name}}
bibleget-source-edition:
The edition in {{msg-mw|bibleget-source}}.

Parameters:
* $1 - the edition's full name, as BibleGet gives it (e.g. New American Bible - Revised Edition)
* $2 - its year (e.g. 2011)
bibleget-source-name:
{{optional}}
Text of the link in {{msg-mw|bibleget-source}}: the name of the service.
bibleget-source-page:
{{notranslate}}
The page the source line under each quote links to, which says where the wiki's Bible quotes come from: by default [[Special:BibleGet]]. A wiki may set its own page (for example Project:BibleGet), or "-" for no link.
right-bibleget-manage:
{{doc-right|bibleget-manage}}
The right to manage the BibleGet extension; holders also receive the BibleGet service notices.
bibleget-notice-banner-label: Label at the start of the banner that shows a BibleGet service notice to the wiki's BibleGet managers (when the Echo extension is not installed). Followed by the notice text.
bibleget-notice-link: Text of the link to more information about a BibleGet service notice, in the banner and in the Echo notification.
bibleget-notice-dismiss:
Label of the button that hides a BibleGet service notice banner for good.
{{Identical|Dismiss}}
bibleget-notice-deprecation:
Text of a BibleGet service notice that came only from the API's Deprecation HTTP header, without text of its own.

Parameters:
* $1 - the deprecation date, as YYYY-MM-DD
bibleget-notice-sunset:
Text of a BibleGet service notice that came only from the API's Sunset HTTP header, without text of its own.

Parameters:
* $1 - the sunset date, as YYYY-MM-DD
echo-category-title-bibleget: Name of the Echo notification category for BibleGet service notices, shown in [[Special:Preferences]].
echo-pref-tooltip-bibleget: Tooltip of the BibleGet notification category in [[Special:Preferences]].
bibleget-special-intro: Introduction on [[Special:BibleGet]], the status page for the wiki's BibleGet managers.
bibleget-special-source-heading: Heading on [[Special:BibleGet]], for every reader, of the section saying where the wiki's Bible quotes come from.
bibleget-special-source-intro: On [[Special:BibleGet]]: where the wiki's Bible quotes come from. Keep the two links (BibleGet and the Catholic Digital Commons Foundation; the foundation's name is not translated).
bibleget-special-source-copyright:
On [[Special:BibleGet]]: the copyrighted editions are provided under BibleGet's agreements with their copyright holders.

Parameters:
* $1 - the address of BibleGet's copyright page ({{msg-mw|bibleget-copyright-url}})
bibleget-special-editions-heading: Heading on [[Special:BibleGet]] above the table of the Bible editions this wiki has quoted.
bibleget-special-editions-edition: Column heading on [[Special:BibleGet]]: the edition's full name.
bibleget-special-editions-abbr: Column heading on [[Special:BibleGet]]: the edition's abbreviation (e.g. NABRE).
bibleget-special-editions-year: Column heading on [[Special:BibleGet]]: the edition's year.
bibleget-special-editions-holder: Column heading on [[Special:BibleGet]]: who holds the edition's copyright (empty for a public-domain edition).
bibleget-special-editions-none: On [[Special:BibleGet]], instead of the editions table, when no quote has been fetched yet.
bibleget-copyright-url:
{{notranslate}}
Address of BibleGet's page with the copyright notices of the editions it provides, linked from [[Special:BibleGet]].
bibleget-special-mode-heading: Heading of the section on [[Special:BibleGet]] telling how the wiki authenticates with the BibleGet service.
bibleget-special-mode-project-key: Shown on [[Special:BibleGet]] when the wiki is configured with a BibleGet project key.
bibleget-special-mode-registered: Shown on [[Special:BibleGet]] when the wiki has registered itself with the BibleGet service.
bibleget-special-mode-unregistered: Shown on [[Special:BibleGet]] when the wiki has neither a project key nor a registration yet.
bibleget-special-mode-site-address:
Shown on [[Special:BibleGet]] when the wiki has no project key and its address is not a public https address, so it does not register.

Parameters:
* $1 - the wiki's address ($wgCanonicalServer).

"$wgBibleGetApiKey" is a configuration variable and must not be translated.
bibleget-special-limits-heading: Heading of the section on [[Special:BibleGet]] listing the quote limits.
bibleget-special-limit-verses:
Parameters:
* $1 - the maximum number of verses rendered for one quote
bibleget-special-limit-quotes:
Parameters:
* $1 - the maximum number of quotes rendered on one page
bibleget-special-ratelimit-heading: Heading of the list of the rate limits of quote fetching.
bibleget-special-ratelimit-line:
One rate limit.

Parameters:
* $1 - the user group the limit applies to (anon, ip, newbie, user, ...)
* $2 - the number of fetches allowed
* $3 - the period in seconds
bibleget-special-ratelimit-none: Shown when no rate limit is configured for quote fetching.
bibleget-special-failure-heading: Heading of the section on [[Special:BibleGet]] showing the last failure of a call to the BibleGet service.
bibleget-special-failure-line:
Parameters:
* $1 - the error message of the last failure
* $2 - the date and time of the failure
bibleget-special-failure-none: Shown when no failure of the BibleGet service has been recorded.
bibleget-special-notices-heading: Heading of the list of BibleGet service notices on [[Special:BibleGet]].
bibleget-special-notices-none: Shown when the wiki has received no service notice.
bibleget-special-notice-line:
Parameters:
* $1 - the notice text
* $2 - the date and time the wiki first saw the notice
bibleget-special-notice-link:
Text of the link to more information about a service notice.
{{Identical|More information}}
bibleget-special-notices-missing-table: Shown on [[Special:BibleGet]] when the extension's database tables do not exist. update.php is MediaWiki's database update script.
